title: Keep legacy prompt text for validation errors
body:
Business users reported that the new system's validation prompts differ from the old screens, which gets in the way of side-by-side acceptance. This PR restores the original legacy screen text for the validation prompts of customer, account and card maintenance, and includes the field name in `details` so the frontend can locate the input box.

## Validation

- Compared the prompt text against `COACTUPC` and `COCRDUPC` one by one, 31 in total.
- Controller tests assert `details[].field`.
author: Chen Chen
